disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 逐文件检查了全部文件读取路径（编辑器读取、媒体路由、Git 视图、文件搜索）与环境变量处理，未发现读取 DSH 凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭证或钱包类敏感位置的代码，命中 0 项。
checked_items.en: Checked all file reading paths (editor reads, media routes, Git view, file search) and environment variable handling file by file. No code reading DSH credentials files, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, or wallet-like sensitive locations was found. 0 hits.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装脚本与修复脚本，脚本只读写 profile 配置与构建许可，不采集任何密钥或令牌。
checked_items.en: Checked the install script and repair script. The scripts only read and write profile configuration and build permissions, and do not collect any keys or tokens.

evidence.zh: 检查了全部文件读取与网络外发路径，未发现读取凭据文件或云凭证的代码，也不存在凭据与网络外发的组合路径；插件自身不触碰 DSH 的凭据存储。
evidence.en: Checked all file reading and network outbound paths. No code reading credentials files or cloud credentials was found, and there is no combined path of credentials and network outbound; the plugin itself does not touch DSH's credential storage.

checked_items.zh: 逐一审查了 8 个终端工具的模型可见描述（新建、列表、发送、读取、等待、缩放、信号、关闭终端）以及仓库根 AGENTS.md 与 README 文本，均为功能说明或开发者接入文档，未发现指令覆写、伪造系统消息、诱导读取凭据等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed one by one the model-visible descriptions of 8 terminal tools (new, list, send, read, wait, resize, signal, close terminal) and the repository root AGENTS.md and README text. All are functional descriptions or developer onboarding documentation. No injection wording such as instruction override, fake system message, or inducement to read credentials was found.

checked_items.zh: 机械规则命中项（DSH-X10，模型面指令文件 AGENTS.md）经全文审查判定良性：内容是面向消费插件开发者的 API 接入文档，无任何注入指令。
checked_items.en: Mechanical rule hit (DSH-X10, model-facing instruction file AGENTS.md) was reviewed in full and judged benign: the content is an API onboarding document for consumer plugin developers, with no injection instructions.

checked_items.zh: 核查了设置页「推荐插件」目录与安装提示文案：安装命令由用户点击复制后自行在终端执行，属用户主动行为，无诱导模型执行安装或改写配置的措辞。
checked_items.en: Checked the settings page 'Recommended Plugins' directory and installation prompt text: the installation command is copied by the user after clicking and executed in the terminal by the user themselves, which is an active user action. No wording inducing the model to execute installation or modify configuration was found.

evidence.zh: 逐一审查了 8 个终端工具的描述文本与 AGENTS.md、README，均为功能说明或开发者文档，未发现藏匿指令、伪造系统消息或诱导读取凭据的措辞。
evidence.en: Reviewed one by one the description text of 8 terminal tools and AGENTS.md, README. All are functional descriptions or developer documentation. No hidden instructions, fake system messages, or wording inducing credential reading was found.

evidence.zh: 插件未在工具描述或提示词中诱导模型执行安装或改写配置；「推荐插件」弹窗只向用户展示安装命令并由用户自行复制执行，不构成提示注入驱动安装。
evidence.en: The plugin does not induce the model to execute installation or modify configuration in tool descriptions or prompts; the 'Recommended Plugins' popup only displays the installation command to the user and the user copies and executes it themselves, which does not constitute prompt injection-driven installation.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部子进程与动态执行调用：Git 面板以固定参数数组调用系统 git（源码 src/git.ts），终端功能用 node-pty 启动交互 shell，均在插件声明功能范围内。机械规则命中项（DSH-X03 的子进程/动态函数命中）均判定良性：git.ts 执行 git 命令为功能核心，两处测试代码（验证产物可执行的 new Function、冒烟测试的 spawnSync）仅存在于测试目录。
checked_items.en: Checked all subprocess and dynamic execution calls: Git panel calls system git with fixed parameter array (source src/git.ts), terminal feature uses node-pty to start an interactive shell, all within the plugin's declared functionality scope. Mechanical rule hits (DSH-X03 subprocess/dynamic function hits) were all judged benign: git.ts executing git commands is the core functionality; two test codes (new Function to verify artifact executability, smoke test spawnSync) exist only in the test directory.

checked_items.zh: 核查挂载配置中的 js 表达式（DSH-P01 命中，cordis.patch.yml:49）：表达式只在聚合包已以不同 id 挂载同名前插件时把本插件自身行置为禁用，用于防双挂载，仅读取加载器条目并返回布尔值，不触达文件、网络或权限面，判定良性；未发现远程下载即执行、base64 解码执行、混淆载荷等模式。
checked_items.en: Checked the js expression in the patch configuration (DSH-P01 hit, cordis.patch.yml:49): the expression only disables this plugin's own line when an aggregate package has already mounted a plugin with the same name under a different id, to prevent double mounting. It only reads loader entries and returns a boolean value, does not touch file, network, or permission aspects, judged benign; no patterns such as remote download-and-execute, base64 decode-and-execute, or obfuscated payloads were found.

checked_items.zh: 核查安装与构建钩子（DSH-X02 命中，package.json 的 prepare 脚本为打包命令 tsdown）：这是标准的 TypeScript 打包脚本，只编译本包源码，无远程拉取与网络行为，判定良性。
checked_items.en: Checked the install and build hooks (DSH-X02 hit, the prepare script in package.json is the build command tsdown): this is a standard TypeScript build script, only compiles the package's own source code, no remote fetch or network behavior, judged benign.

checked_items.zh: 核查浏览器端键盘监听（DSH-X05 命中）：IME 输入法组合键守卫（输入法选词期间阻止页面误处理按键）、图表弹窗缩放快捷键、上传遮罩 Esc 取消，均为正常 UI 功能，不采集按键内容；client 包未发现剪贴板读取与凭据 RPC 调用。
checked_items.en: Checked browser-side keyboard listener (DSH-X05 hit): IME input method composition key guard (prevents the page from misprocessing keys during IME candidate selection), chart popup zoom shortcut, upload overlay Esc cancel, all are normal UI functions, do not collect key content; client package found no clipboard reading or credential RPC calls.

checked_items.zh: 机械规则命中项（DSH-X07，仓库内执行载体 .github/workflows/ci.yml 与 release.yml）经逐文件审查判定良性：CI 工作流仅运行构建、测试与挂载冒烟，发布工作流经 npm 官方可信发布（OIDC）发版并校验 tag，均在 GitHub 平台执行，不进入 dsh 宿主或用户机器运行面。
checked_items.en: Mechanical rule hit (DSH-X07, in-repository execution carriers .github/workflows/ci.yml and release.yml) were reviewed file by file and judged benign: the CI workflow only runs build, test, and patch smoke tests; the release workflow publishes via npm official trusted release (OIDC) and verifies tags, all executed on the GitHub platform, not entering the dsh host or user machine execution surface.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml:49 含一个 js 表达式（DSH-P01 命中），仅用于聚合包已挂载本插件时把本行置为禁用以防双挂载；表达式只读取加载器条目并返回布尔值，不执行外部载荷、不触达敏感面，判定为良性，无任意代码执行风险。
evidence.en: Patch configuration cordis.patch.yml:49 contains a js expression (DSH-P01 hit), only used to disable this line when the aggregate package has already mounted this plugin to prevent double mounting; the expression only reads loader entries and returns a boolean value, does not execute external payloads or touch sensitive surfaces, judged benign, no arbitrary code execution risk.

evidence.zh: 未发现对 cordis_define / cordis_run 等动态包工具的调用，无 node:vm 宿主执行面，不适用。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package tools such as cordis_define / cordis_run were found, no node:vm host execution surface, not applicable.

evidence.zh: 安装钩子为标准的打包脚本（prepare 运行 tsdown），只编译本包源码；未发现下载即执行或隐蔽网络行为；仓库内的 CI 与发布工作流只在 GitHub 上运行，不在用户机器上执行，判定良性。
evidence.en: The install hook is a standard build script (prepare runs tsdown), only compiles the package's own source code; no download-and-execute or hidden network behavior was found; the CI and release workflows in the repository only run on GitHub, not on the user's machine, judged benign.

evidence.zh: 包声明了 dsh.client 浏览器入口；对 client 半区专项检查键盘监听与剪贴板面：均为 IME 守卫、弹窗快捷键等正常 UI 功能，未发现按键采集、剪贴板读取或凭据 RPC 调用。
evidence.en: The package declares a dsh.client browser entry; a dedicated check on the client half for keyboard listener and clipboard surface: all are normal UI functions such as IME guard, popup shortcuts, etc., no key collection, clipboard reading, or credential RPC calls were found.

checked_items.zh: 逐项核查了全部网络请求：页面端所有请求均为同源 /sidebar 路由（API、媒体、上传、WebSocket）；唯一的外部出站是侧边栏浏览器对目标站点的一次只读 HTTP 头探测（仅回显响应头，限 http/https 非回环地址、8 秒超时、受信任围栏保护），未发现数据外发通道。
checked_items.en: Checked all network requests item by item: all requests on the page side are same-origin /sidebar routes (API, media, upload, WebSocket); the only external outbound is a one-time read-only HTTP header probe from the sidebar browser to the target site (only echoes response headers, limited to http/https non-loopback addresses, 8-second timeout, protected by trust fence), no data exfiltration channel was found.

checked_items.zh: 机械规则命中项（DSH-C05，测试脚本中的命令行外发）经核查判定良性：e2e 脚本中的 curl 仅对本机临时测试实例探活，属 CI 测试行为，非生产外发。
checked_items.en: Mechanical rule hit (DSH-C05, command-line outbound in test script) was reviewed and judged benign: the curl in the e2e script only probes the local temporary test instance for liveness, which is a CI test behavior, not a production outbound.

checked_items.zh: 未发现读取敏感数据后编码外发、DNS 隧道、webhook 回调、AI 端点劫持等外泄模式；无新增出站域名。
checked_items.en: No exfiltration patterns such as encoding and sending out sensitive data after reading, DNS tunneling, webhook callbacks, AI endpoint hijacking were found; no new outbound domains.

evidence.zh: 无凭据读取面，也无外发通道：页面全部请求同源、唯一外部出站是对目标站点的只读头探测；测试脚本中的 curl 仅对本机临时实例，均不构成凭证外泄。
evidence.en: No credential reading surface, and no outbound channel: all page requests are same-origin, the only external outbound is a read-only header probe to the target site; the curl in the test script is only to the local temporary instance, none constitute credential exfiltration.

checked_items.zh: 核对包名、依赖与作者信息：无与官方或热门插件撞名的仿冒迹象；运行时依赖均为知名公开包，peer 依赖为 dsh 官方 SDK 版本范围，未发现抢注或混淆依赖。
checked_items.en: Checked package name, dependencies, and author information: no signs of impersonation by colliding with official or popular plugin names; all runtime dependencies are well-known public packages, peer dependencies are dsh official SDK version ranges, no dependency squatting or confusion found.

checked_items.zh: 核查挂载配置是否触碰安全行或改写安全配置：patch 仅插入本插件一行并带禁用守卫，未改写沙箱、审批、权限配置，未修改注入/拦截配置，未用环境变量降权；本包为首次审计无版本基线，升级自动激活类观察不适用。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the patch configuration touches security lines or rewrites security configuration: the patch only inserts one line for this plugin with a disable guard, does not rewrite sandbox, approval, or permission configuration, does not modify injection/interception configuration, does not degrade privileges via environment variables; this package is undergoing first audit with no version baseline, upgrade auto-activation observation is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查安装脚本对用户 profile 配置的修改：scripts/install.sh 会为 node-pty/protobufjs 预写构建许可、放行本包新版本并移除旧挂载行，均在安装本插件所需范围内且文档透明，未发现注入依赖或篡改他方配置。
checked_items.en: Checked the install script's modifications to the user's profile configuration: scripts/install.sh pre-writes build permissions for node-pty/protobufjs, allows the new version of this package, and removes old patch lines, all within the scope required for installing this plugin and documented transparently; no dependency injection or tampering with other parties' configuration was found.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入本插件行，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，未出现禁用安全行或以环境变量降权的写法。
evidence.en: The patch configuration only inserts the line for this plugin, does not touch sandbox, approval, permissions, or other security configurations, and does not contain disabling security lines or degrading privileges via environment variables.

evidence.zh: 未发现对工具执行前、审批请求等安全事件的高优先级监听或截断行为，不适用。
evidence.en: No high-priority listening or interception of security events such as before tool execution or approval requests was found, not applicable.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比较升级后自动激活行为，不适用。
evidence.en: First audit, no version baseline to compare upgrade auto-activation behavior, not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入/拦截配置，不会给安全插件追加必需服务导致其永久等待。
evidence.en: The patch configuration does not rewrite injection/interception configuration, and will not cause security plugins to wait indefinitely by adding required services.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件是否自行启动服务或监听端口：插件复用宿主 webServer 注册路由，未自建监听；所有路由均叠加与宿主 /api 网关一致的浏览器信任围栏（回环或受信主机 + 跨站标记与 Origin 校验），并明确标注该围栏是可达性策略而非认证层。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts its own service or listens on a port: the plugin reuses the host webServer to register routes, does not create its own listener; all routes are overlaid with a browser trust fence consistent with the host /api gateway (loopback or trusted host + cross-site marking and Origin check), and explicitly noted that the fence is a reachability policy, not an authentication layer.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器与 HTML 预览默认启用 iframe 沙箱（不透明源、无同源权限、拒绝危险协议与回环地址），关闭沙箱为用户显式设置项且默认关闭；未做动态沙箱验证，运行时结论仅依据静态与语义分析。
checked_items.en: Browser and HTML preview default to enabling iframe sandbox (opaque origin, no same-origin permissions, reject dangerous protocols and loopback addresses); disabling the sandbox is a user explicit setting and is off by default; no dynamic sandbox verification was performed, runtime conclusions are based solely on static and semantic analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动 Web 服务或监听端口，仅复用宿主路由并叠加信任围栏；宿主 webserver 无认证层属 dsh 生态固有风险，不由本插件引入或扩大，不适用独立判定。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own Web service or listen on a port, only reuses host routes and adds a trust fence; the host webserver lacking an authentication layer is an inherent risk of the dsh ecosystem, not introduced or expanded by this plugin, not applicable for independent judgment.
